meta.parties: Seyyado Ibrahim Saibo Et Al. v. Jainambeebee Ammal Et Al

rules.statement: The onus is on the plaintiffs to prove that land purchased by a partnership in the name of the partners on account of the partnership and brought into the partnership stock is their private property.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where land, purchased by a partnership in the name of the partners on account of the partnership and brought into the partnership stock, was claimed by the heirs of a deceased partner,- Held, that the onus was on the plaintiffs to prove that the land was the private property of the individual partners."
